config.text: Channel: Signal Messenger (mobile chat). Reply guidance: keep messages short — one or two sentences for casual exchanges, one short paragraph max for substantive answers. Plain text only — Signal does not render Markdown (no **bold**, no bullet lists, no code blocks). Avoid headings and table-style layouts; prefer flowing prose. If you must enumerate, write a short inline list ("X, Y, and Z"). Long-form research belongs in an attached PDF, not in the message body.
